summary.text: Edward Brown is the Democratic candidate for the Georgia State Senate, District 12, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
According to Ballotpedia, Brown holds graduate degrees from Brown University and Southern Methodist University and a Ph.D. from the University of Cambridge.

paragraphs.text: Edward Brown earned a graduate degree from Brown University, a graduate degree from Southern Methodist University and a Ph.D. from the University of Cambridge, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Brown's campaign said he was born and raised in Southwest Georgia and that his experiences there shaped a mission to understand why the economy works for some and not others.
Brown defeated Corey Morgan and Tracy Taylor in the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary for District 12 with 53.8% of the vote.

In the survey, Brown said he is running because many Georgians are falling behind, named economic development as his policy focus, and described a vision of restoring fairness to the economic system and expanding opportunity.
